scope: READ-ONLY inventory of YURI-OS-MUSUBI + LOCAL AI LAB + Hermes yuri artifacts for an always-on local assistant assessment. Haze excluded by instruction.

a_what_it_is.summary: YURI-OS-MUSUBI is a governance/control-plane monorepo for AI-assisted work ('deterministic gateway for AI') with a real Express+React app inside. It is NOT a personal voice assistant. PROJECTS/YURI-OS-MUSUBI is a 2-file launch folder; the real repo is the dirty Mac-migration snapshot under 04_PROJECTS.

structure._SYSTEM/: control plane: backend, frontend, 712 scripts, memory, mure fleet, docs, labs
structure._SYSTEM/backend/: Express 5 + TypeScript API, better-sqlite3, data/yuri.db, PM2 port 3004
structure._SYSTEM/src/: Vite/React operator/portfolio shell (NOT a chat app), port 5173
structure._SYSTEM/Scripts/: 712 files: memory-kernel.mjs, ollama lanes, autonomy runner, workcell, voice/
structure._SYSTEM/memory/: markdown index; real DBs in _SYSTEM/OS_KERNEL/ (memory.db, memory-cold.db, search-index.db)

reuse_as_is: LOCAL AI LAB wholesale: Vulkan llama.cpp builds, 3 chat scripts, model set, measured perf
Bonsai-Abliterated PQ2_0 on :8083 as the assistant brain (full VRAM fit, ~26 t/s, vision, no refusals)
Yuri persona ~/.hermes/personalities/yuri.txt as system prompt (Bonsai accepts one)
reuse_with_surgery: Memory kernel recall core (memory-kernel.mjs + static-encoder.mjs): portable zero-infra Node ESM, but extract from _SYSTEM/state/ path coupling
Guarded-executor pattern (yuri-guarded-executor.mjs, executor.ts): reimplement the small allowlist-and-log pattern, don't port Mac-coupled files
Voice loop architecture (voice/bot.py): reuse the VAD->STT->brain->TTS barge-in shape; rewrite all code (Pipecat/MLX/Kokoro are Apple-only)
rebuild_or_leave: The YURI-OS-MUSUBI monorepo itself: 319k lines governance .mjs, no node_modules, dirty mid-migration, launchd/keychain/MLX coupling, no chat UI, no wake word - a coding-AI control plane, not an assistant runtime
MLX voice stack, launchd plists, keychain env.sh, Vite operator site, remotion folders
minimal_plan_hey_nexus: 1. systemd user unit running chat-bonsai-abliterated.sh (port 8083, full VRAM; one chat model at a time per documented VRAM rule)
2. openwakeword (pip, onnxruntime CPU) with trained 'hey nexus' model, reading default PipeWire source via sounddevice/pw-cat at 16kHz
3. faster-whisper (CTranslate2 CPU int8, small/base.en) VAD-gated ASR; barge-in = stop TTS on new speech
4. Brain: POST http://127.0.0.1:8083/v1/chat/completions with yuri.txt system prompt + rolling history; tool calls = small allowlisted action map (guarded-executor pattern), sqlite-logged
5. TTS: real piper-tts (pip piper-tts or AUR; NOT the pacman piper mouse GUI) en_US onnx voice to default PipeWire sink, ~100ms first-audio on CPU
6. Memory later: extract static-encoder.mjs cosine recall into sidecar; append-only JSONL first
d_verdict.effort_estimate: One ~400-line Python/Node daemon + 4 new packages (openwakeword, faster-whisper, piper-tts, sounddevice). Zero monorepo porting.
